subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` config value now through this doctor migration, or preserve the contract until a real gRPC exporter is implemented?
rationale: Both directions are technically possible, but automation cannot decide whether a previously shipped public config value may be removed and whether doctor may disable affected telemetry during upgrade.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
options.body: Accept the migration-backed removal because current runtime and dependencies implement only HTTP/protobuf, then refresh and merge the PR.

options.title: Preserve gRPC contract
options.body: Keep `grpc` accepted and replace or defer this patch until trace, metric, and log gRPC exporters are implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
recommendation.body: Accept the migration-backed removal because current runtime and dependencies implement only HTTP/protobuf, then refresh and merge the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent merged history in the diagnostics OTel runtime and tests that define the behavior being retired.
